options.description: Disables personalized sticker suggestion popups and typing recommendations in direct messages.
options.title: Suppress Sticker Recommendations

options.description: Suppresses repetitive PopLayer prompts including favorites collection guides, launcher shortcut dialogs, repost newbie sheets, STEM feed prompts, campus education sheets, creator inbox guides, app review dialogs, marketing opt-ins, FYP surveys, CapCut/Lemon8 upsells, profile visitor prompts, and story intro sheets.
options.title: Filter PopLayer Prompts & Nags

options.description: Disables floating live stream preview teasers and popup windows from appearing over the video feed.
options.title: Suppress Live Teaser Bubbles

options.description: Suppresses direct message streak expiration warning banners and inline urgency reminders.
options.title: Suppress DM Streak Reminders

description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos and re-applies it when new videos start.
name: Remember Clear Display

description: Throttles background sensor polling (gyroscope/accelerometer 3D ads) and prevents aggressive video buffer preloading to conserve battery and CPU resources.
name: Resource & Battery Governor

description: Strips embedded third-party license text, onboarding tutorial Lottie animations, promotional GIFs, and APK root metadata/junk files.
name: Resource Slimmer

description: Strips embedded onboarding MP4 tutorial video, heavy IMG.LY photo editor stickers/textures, and compiler junk metadata.
name: Resource Slimmer

description: Remembers playback timestamp when scrolling away and resumes from where playback stopped upon returning.
name: Resume Video After Scroll

description: Neutralizes motion, ambient, and orientation sensor providers to prevent hardware fingerprinting and tracking via Generic Sensor APIs.
name: Sensor Privacy Guard

description: Displays the creator's country or region code next to their username in video author info across feeds and deep-linked detail views.
name: Show Author Region

description: Restores TikTok's native video seekbar and scrubbing controls where normally hidden or disabled.
name: Show Seekbar

options.description: Displays real-time video frame thumbnail previews while dragging the seekbar thumb.
options.title: Show Dragging Thumbnail Preview

description: Spoofs the detected SIM and network country ISO code, operator numeric codes, operator names, and cell identity MCC/MNC to bypass regional feed restrictions and catalog blocks.
name: SIM Region Selector

options.description: Two-letter ISO country code for SIM and network country spoofing (e.g. 'CH', 'US', 'JP', 'GB').
options.title: Spoofed Region ISO Code

options.description: 5-6 digit MCC+MNC code (e.g. '22801' for Switzerland/Swisscom) used to spoof TelephonyManager operator queries and CellIdentity MCC/MNC reads. Empty keeps stock operator values.
options.title: Spoofed Operator Numeric Code (MCC+MNC)

options.description: Display name reported for SIM/network operator queries (e.g. 'Swisscom'). Empty keeps the stock operator name.
options.title: Spoofed Operator Name

description: Bypasses and clears sensitive content warnings, graphic media blur overlays, and age gates on feed videos.
name: Skip Content Warnings
